program: University of Rome Tor Vergata — Digital Processes for Building Design and Construction
description: A parametric Revit model of a 1960s prefabricated housing complex, rebuilt from historical documentation, original patents and an as-built survey.
body: A full BIM model in Revit of an existing prefabricated housing complex built in the 1960s near Milan, reconstructed from historical documentation, original construction patents and as-built conditions surveyed via Google Maps.

The model covers both architectural and structural modeling with custom parametric families — including a catalogue of façade panel types — supported by a Common Data Environment and data extraction into Excel for further analysis.
